messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - sev2 possible cross-tenant data exposure detected in routing-service. Alert id: alert-68291. Affected pool: dedicated-gpu-pool-7. Link: https://alerts.internal/redwood/alert-68291
oncall-sre (jamie): I'm oncall, looking. Pulling logs and routing table now. ETA 5m.
sec-bot: Detection: abnormal routing header 'x-tenant-id' mismatches observed; 7 requests forwarded to tenant-agg node not in pool mapping. Sample keys: tenant_id=acme-corp vs expected acme-corp:d3f. Timestamps ~ 2026-03-15T22:04Z
Alice M: I see traffic spike from dedicated-gpu-pool-7 -> shared-raft-proxy at 22:03. Likely routing-service returned fallback route. Checking rollout history for routing config v3.14.
Ben S: Marking incident TLP:AMBER. If confirmed cross-tenant exposure, escalate to legal and CSM. Do not share logs externally.
Olivia C: Olivia CSM here. I'm on standby to notify AcmeCorp's security contact. Please confirm scope before I call.
Dave P: I can hotfix routing-service to enforce tenant pinning. Preparing image with stricter check: if tenant header mismatch, reject and 403. Will push a canary to one node first.
oncall-sre (jamie): Runbook step executed: 1) capture pcap from front proxy 2) dump routing table 3) rotate pool mapping cache. Commands I'm running:
```
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/front-proxy -- tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/proxy-ppcap.pcap
kubectl -n infra exec routing-service -- /bin/sh -c 'curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/debug/routing-table > /tmp/routing-table.json'
```
Carol R: Also request a KV cache dump from model-serving nodes; previous incidents showed stale cache keys cause misroutes.
Mike T: Filing internal incident ticket IR-20260315-73 and linking customer ticket CS-9982.
sec-bot: Auto-scan of logs found 42 distinct requests where tenant header != pool mapping. Potentially exposed fields: prompt_text, metadata.user_id. No full key material or secret tokens detected. Severity estimate: medium. Stored samples to secure bucket s3://internal-sec/incidents/alert-68291 (access: sec-team only).
Ben S: Start immediate mitigations: 1) pause traffic to dedicated-gpu-pool-7 2) rotate pool auth tokens 3) remove affected nodes from LB
oncall-sre (jamie): Pausing pool now. Run: `rbacctl set-pool-state dedicated-gpu-pool-7 drained` -> OK. Confirming zero active sessions now.
Dave P: Deployed hotfix 3.14.2 with tenant-pin. Canary on node routing-7b -> healthy. Rolling to remaining routing pods in 2m.
Olivia C: I've informed AcmeCorp security lead that we're investigating and have paused their dedicated pool as a precaution. They asked for ETA on restore.
Alice M: KV cache dumps in /tmp/kv-dumps show no keys from AcmeCorp in other tenants' caches. Cross-tenant payloads appear limited to request headers and small prompt snippets. Need to run content scan.
sec-bot: Content-scan results: 18 lines of prompt_text with PII-like user names; no SSN or payment data. Flagged entries quarantined. Records written to secure bucket with restricted ACL.
Legal (erin): Please cc legal@redwood when you post final timeline. We'll evaluate breach notification requirements based on scope.
Carol R: Suggest running routing misconfig audit script across all dedicated pools:
```
for p in $(list-pools --type dedicated); do curl http://routing-service/pools/$p/config | jq '.tenant_pin, .fallback_policy'; done
```
Ben S: Good idea. Run across europe and us zones. If any pool uses fallback -> shared, patch to fail instead.
oncall-sre (jamie): Audit script run started. Initial run shows 3 pools in EU with fallback=shared. Opening follow-up tasks to patch.
Mike T: Noted customer notified. CS ticket updated with initial timeline and mitigations. CS asked for a written summary in 2 hours.
Dave P: We've pushed policy change to disallow fallback=shared. Rolling update in progress across 120 pods. Expected completion ~ 22:50Z.
sec-bot: All new requests now fail with 403 if tenant header missing/mismatch. Monitoring for 30m.
oncall-sre (jamie): Monitoring shows no further misroutes after enforcement. Last suspicious timestamp 22:11Z. setting incident state -> mitigated
Olivia C: Customer accepted pause and is requesting a joint postmortem and an assurance plan for VPC/dedicated pools. I'll coordinate dates.
Alice M: Action items: collect final audit logs, confirm token rotations, run end-to-end test with customer tenancy, draft postmortem. I'll own the postmortem.
Ben S: Security action items: run full SIEM correlation, produce list of exposed users, check S3 bucket access logs, prepare notification draft if legal requires.
Legal (erin): We'll triage notifications once you provide list. Hold public comms until counsel reviews.
oncall-sre (jamie): Handoff to daytime oncall at 1743161400. Handoff notes: mitigations applied, pool drained, hotfix deployed, monitoring green. If any regressions, page SRE and sec.
incident-bot: Incident updated: IR-20260315-73 state=mitigated. Closing pager for oncall-jamie. :lock:
Olivia C: Thanks team. I'll set up a sync with AcmeCorp for tomorrow. Please keep any raw logs and evidence preserved for at least 90 days.
Alice M: Copy. I'll attach preserved artifacts to the incident ticket and start the postmortem draft.
Mike T: Closing slack thread for live coordination. Postmortem channel will be #postmortems once draft is ready. :thumbsup:
